status.en: 17 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Kivu, Kinshasa and Kigali.
status.nb: 17 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Kivu, Kinshasa og Kigali.

summary.en: M23 rebels have withdrawn from near Bunia after heavy clashes but opened a new front near the Uganda border and are advancing on Uvira city. WHO evacuated its Ebola response team from an Ituri hospital after they were trapped by fighting, and the Ebola death rate is now near 50%. A Congolese military aircraft went missing after rebels claimed to have shot it down, leading to the capture of a South African mercenary. The conflict has displaced 8.2 million people and caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: M23‑opprørerne har trukket seg tilbake fra området ved Bunia etter tunge kamper, men har åpnet en ny front ved grensen mot Uganda og rykker frem mot byen Uvira. WHO evakuerte sitt ebolateam fra et sykehus i Ituri etter at de ble fanget i kampene, og eboladødsraten er nå nær 50 %. Et kongolesisk militærfly forsvant etter at opprørerne hevdet å ha skutt det ned, noe som førte til at en sørafrikansk leiesoldat ble tatt. Konflikten har fordrevet 8.2 millioner mennesker og forårsaket 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
